title: Premium Billing Accounts Billing Terms: Invoicing and Premium Computation
content:
### 1. Invoices
Each invoice is issued the arrangement's invoice lead time before the premium due day of its first month. Coverage always begins and ends on month boundaries, so no partial month is ever billed.

> **Former clause — no longer in force in its general form:** "Each invoice bills the arrangement's months per invoice, whole coverage months, starting with the next unbilled month."
> This clause continues to govern every invoice other than the premium for a vision plan that the account holder applies for on a Cascade Individual Annual Prepay account after that account's renewal invoice is issued; for such a plan, and only for such a plan, the premium is collected with the renewal payment. Every other invoice bills the arrangement's months per invoice, whole coverage months, starting with the next unbilled month.

### 2. Individual premium
For individual arrangements the monthly premium is the sum, over every applied or active plan the account funds, of that plan's monthly premium for its coverage tier (a Dental PPO Plans or Vision Plans plan charged once per plan unit), plus the orthodontic rider monthly premium per enrollee for each applied or active orthodontic rider.

### 3. Exchange accounts
On an exchange account the invoice bills the monthly premium less the account's monthly advance premium tax credit (never below 0.00), and the exchange's credit is booked as a separate payment by the exchange APTC method.

### 4. Discounts
> **Former clause — no longer in force in its general form:** "AutoPay accounts receive the arrangement's AutoPay discount off each billed month."
> Every billed month of an AutoPay account keeps its monthly AutoPay discount, other than the months for which a grace-cure payment withdraws the discount — past-due months and the not-yet-begun month of the invoice issued last, and only those months — where the discount is added back with the grace-cure payment.

An annual prepay invoice bills twelve months less the prepay discount percentage, rounded half up to the cent.

### 5. Group premium
For group arrangements the monthly premium is the group contract's rate for each coverage tier multiplied by the subscribers enrolled in that tier on the first of the month. A self-administered group reports its own enrollment and pays on its report, and the carrier reconciles every reconciliation interval (in months).

### 6. Late fees
No late fee is ever billed (the late fee is 0.00 on every arrangement).

**Worked example (hypothetical premiums).** An individual account funds an active dental plan at 52.00 a month for its tier, an active vision plan at 9.50 and one active orthodontic rider at 18.00 per enrollee: the monthly premium is 79.50. On Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill one invoice bills 3 months, 238.50. On Cascade Individual Annual Prepay twelve months total 954.00, less 4 percent (38.16), so the invoice bills 915.84.
